parameters.note: Watson Lake is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation in §5.85(a)(1) (open all year). Watson Lake sits near the headwaters of Watson Creek (its outflow merges with the creek a short distance downstream, across a granite ridge from the creek's own source meadow); Watson Creek flows generally east and discharges into Lake Tahoe at Carnelian Bay, making Watson Creek a Lake Tahoe tributary. The Tahoe tributary special regulation, §7.50(b)(152)(A), covers 'Tahoe Lake tributaries upstream to the first lake' — that boundary stops at the first lake, so it governs Watson Creek below the lake, not Watson Lake itself. The lake therefore follows the general lake regulation.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water). The lake sits near the headwaters of Watson Creek, a Lake Tahoe tributary, but the §7.50(b)(152) tributary closure applies only to the creek below the lake, not to the lake itself.
